subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these five public memory role slots, including per-agent overrides and hook-level role gating, as the permanent plugin and configuration contract?
rationale: Implementation review cannot determine the long-term breadth and semantics of new public config keys, SDK types, hook behavior, migration rules, and per-agent routing.

options.title: Sponsor the five-role contract
options.body: Approve the proposed taxonomy in principle and require exact-head upgrade and runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Land only roles with complete runtime semantics and defer broader ownership or per-agent behavior.

options.title: Pause this architecture
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open while maintainers choose a different memory composition model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the five-role contract
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed taxonomy in principle and require exact-head upgrade and runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The central plugin/config history and prior canonical-issue routing make this the strongest available owner for the permanent public API choice.
